tw: Kron pours four good scoops of treasure in the pot, then one more for good measure.
twc: Kron 往锅里倒了四勺好宝贝，又额外多加了一勺。
hint: 汤里加金币，多一勺更香。

tw: Kron heaves seven heavy pancakes up the cloud stairs to heaven at eleven.
twc: Kron 十一点把七张沉甸甸的煎饼扛上云梯送去天堂。

tw: Kron sings a slow solo so low that the snow rolls off the roof.
twc: Kron 唱了段又慢又低的独唱，震得屋顶的雪都滑下来了。
hint: 独唱太低，雪先听不下去。

tw: Kron and ten brown hounds get down to the brown dough downtown.
twc: Kron 和十只棕色猎犬在市中心开始揉棕色面团。

tw: Posh Kron possesses a pot of cress that makes a mess of his best dress.
twc: 讲究的 Kron 有一盆水芹，把他最好的礼服弄得一团糟。
hint: 拥有一盆草，失去一件衣。

tw: All of a sudden, Kron's tub of suds swells up tall and fills the hall.
twc: 突然，Kron 浴缸里的泡沫一下涨高，灌满了整个走廊。
hint: 说涨就涨，泡泡不打招呼。

tw: Genius Kron gives the genie new jeans, but the genie has no knees.
twc: 天才 Kron 送了精灵一条新牛仔裤，可精灵根本没有膝盖。

tw: In the big finale, Kron finally slides down a fine valley of jelly.
twc: 在压轴大结局里，Kron 终于从一座果冻山谷滑了下来。

tw: Kron paints a can and a vase on canvas, then a van rolls right across it.
twc: Kron 在画布上画了一个罐子和一个花瓶，结果一辆货车压了过去。

tw: Kron finds a like-minded lion who likes lime ice cream and minds nothing else.
twc: Kron 找到一只志同道合的狮子，只爱青柠冰淇淋，别的都不管。
hint: 同好不用多，一个口味就够。

tw: Kron posed on top of the pot, as opposed to the octopus posed inside it.
twc: Kron 摆姿势坐在锅顶上，章鱼则在锅里摆姿势。

tw: Kron's brushwork works in a rush: he brushes a whole bus with one bush.
twc: Kron 的画法很赶：拿一整棵灌木刷了一辆公交车。

tw: Kron sniffs the essence of seven sweaty socks, and his senses say yes.
twc: Kron 闻了七只汗袜子的精华，他的感官居然说好。

tw: Kron's true calling: calling all the tall dolls to the ball in the hall.
twc: Kron 的真正使命：召唤所有高个玩偶去大厅参加舞会。

tw: Kron bathes a baby whale in a bay, and the whale bathes Kron right back.
twc: Kron 在海湾给小鲸鱼洗澡，鲸鱼反过来给 Kron 洗澡。
hint: 给鲸鱼洗澡，被鲸鱼冲澡。

tw: Kron picks one pixel off the screen, and six pixels pick at his elbow.
twc: Kron 从屏幕上抠下一个像素，六个像素来戳他的胳膊肘。

tw: Kron leads folks from all walks of life to walk the tall wall with a kite.
twc: Kron 带着各行各业的人放着风筝走上高高的城墙。

tw: Kron reads "Go about it slowly" and goes about his boat with a slow goat.
twc: Kron 读到“慢慢做”，就牵着慢吞吞的山羊在船上忙活。

tw: Kron overthrows the snow king, throwing him over his own snow throne.
twc: Kron 推翻了雪国王，把他从雪王座上掀了下去。

tw: "This mess must be down to Kron," frowns the brown cow in the town.
twc: “这摊乱子肯定怪 Kron。”镇上的棕色奶牛皱着眉说。
hint: 嘴上的奶胡子出卖了他。
